footer.demoBody: This is a demo project. Products, prices and orders are not real, the kashrut authorities shown are fictional, no card is charged and no messages are sent.
footer.hours: Sun–Thu 7:00–19:00 · Fri until two hours before Shabbat

home.headline: Fresh meat, honestly weighed.
home.lead: We cut to order, weigh every piece and charge the real weight — never more than we promised.
home.trust1Body: We hold slightly more than the estimate and charge only what we weighed. The difference is released.
home.trust2Body: Authority, glatt, nikur, salting and Passover status — on the product itself, not in a footer.
home.trust3Body: Delivery windows follow candle-lighting times and holidays. We won't promise a delivery that can't arrive.
home.weighExplain1: Choose an amount, say 2.5 kg of entrecôte, and see an estimated price.
home.weighExplain2: At checkout we hold slightly more — up to 10% above the estimate. This is not a charge.
home.weighExplain3: The butcher weighs every piece. You get a message with the final weight and price.
home.weighExplain4: We charge only the final amount. The rest is released back to your card.
